name: What should I look for when choosing a construction project manager?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a construction project manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a construction project manager, look for experience with similar projects, strong communication skills, and a proven track record. Check their portfolio, ask for references, and ensure they have a clear understanding of your vision and budget. Verify their licensing and insurance. A good project manager will be transparent about their fees, responsive to your questions, and demonstrate a proactive approach to problem-solving and risk management.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, strong communication, proven track record, licensing, and insurance. Ensure they understand your vision and are transparent about fees and problem-solving.
